observations: L01, L03: the abjad numerals عح كح (78 28) and يا لب (11 32) each stand under one bar.
L06: العَقْرَب has a fatha over the ʿayn and over the rā' and a sukun over the qāf; the damma of الحُوت printed broken.
L09: قِلَّةً: a kasra under the qāf, a shadda with a fatha over the lām and a fathatan over the tā' marbūṭa (2000 dpi).
L10: أُوقِيَانُس: a hamza and a damma over the alif (one mark 3.2 x 5.8 pt), a kasra under the qāf, a fatha over the yā', a damma over the nūn (2400 dpi).
L17, L18: يُقْطَع (damma over the yā') and يَقْطَع (fatha over the yā'), as printed; both have a sukun over the qāf and a fatha over the ṭā'.
L20: the head of the mīm of بما printed in two pieces (no dot over it; the dot of the bā' stands below).
N02: «αἰθήρ» as printed: smooth breathing on the iota, acute on the eta (the theta in its open form).
N03: under the second letter of فيعترض and of ويحد the dots print as one blob (1.4-1.6 pt), read as the two dots of yā' (the masculine forms of the text's فتعترض and وتحدّ).
